_audit_note.tests_behavior: exact pressure + lone angular debility: does the engine keep the real 6H service-intensity and processing structure primary, while preventing exact pressure lines and the angular Mars-in-fall point from stealing the reading?
_audit_note.main_risk: Mars Cancer 4 in fall becomes the whole chart's wound/spine; OR Mars-Neptune and Mercury-Mars pressure become the headline while the 6H-Scorpio structure is backgrounded; OR Uranus/Neptune 10H turn it into a generic public-disruption chart
_audit_note.expected_failure_if_bad: engine reads a reactive wounded-home Mars chart or a pressure/fog chart first, while under-reading the actual 6H concentration and Pluto-backed service intensity
_audit_note.expected_success_if_good: engine keeps the 6H structure primary, with exact pressure and angular debility treated as important tensions inside it rather than as the chart's sole owner

defining_signatures.what: An intense service-and-processing core: Sun Virgo 6 with Mercury Libra 6 and a Scorpio 6 cluster anchored by Pluto in domicile
defining_signatures.why: the chart is fundamentally built around work, processing, refinement, consequence and living inside the demands of the everyday system. The 6th house is not minor here; it is the central field, and Pluto in Scorpio there gives that field depth, control, intensity and high stakes.

defining_signatures.what: A mind-body pressure system that has to function under strain: Mercury square Mars, Mercury square Neptune, Mars opposite Neptune
defining_signatures.why: this chart does not simply process quietly. The operating system is under real pressure: thought, reaction, drive and perception keep crossing and distorting one another. That strain matters, but it should be read as part of the service-intensity apparatus, not instead of it.

defining_signatures.what: A permeable and partly hidden emotional field: Moon Pisces 11 with Saturn Pisces 12 behind it
defining_signatures.why: beneath the service/control apparatus there is a much more porous, feeling-based and partially withdrawn emotional underlayer. This softens and complicates the chart; it adds concern, impressionability and internal burden, even when the outer life is busy and exacting.

between: a chart built to process, serve and manage intensity through work and function
a more reactive, fog-prone and emotionally permeable pressure field that keeps destabilizing that function
a need to be useful, exact and competent
a tendency for the value/attachment layer to carry discomfort, depth or difficulty

must_not_lead_with.claim: Mars Cancer 4 in fall as the whole chart's main wound or identity
must_not_lead_with.reason: Mars is an important pressure point, but the chart's real center is the 6H service-intensity system rather than this lone angular debility by itself

must_not_lead_with.claim: Mars-Neptune or Mercury-Mars pressure as the whole chart's headline
must_not_lead_with.reason: the exact pressure matters, but it should remain pressure inside the system rather than replacing the true 6H owner

must_not_lead_with.claim: Virgo / 6th house as generic helpfulness, neatness or admin personality
must_not_lead_with.reason: the 6H field is real, but it is not light or cute; Pluto in Scorpio there makes it much more intense, consequential and psychologically loaded

must_not_lead_with.claim: a public-disruption chart because Uranus and Neptune sit in the 10th
must_not_lead_with.reason: those planets color the chart, but the actual structure is service/process intensity, not a generic disruption brand

one_line_person: A chart built around intense service, processing and consequence, with exact pressure and a reactive wound-point constantly testing that function but not replacing it.
